messages:
maria_sales: FYI — Arcadia Labs renewal coming up. They want to rebaseline (current commit 500k tokens/mo) and are asking for an uplift discount for an expanded POC + extra burst capacity. Can Deal Desk review options? :wave:

ajay_se: Quick context — POC will run 6 weeks, needs dedicated capacity for nightly batch evals. They asked about a temporary higher throughput window (2x) for 4 weeks.

maria_sales: Correct. They want price protection for the year if we give them a 12% uplift on committed tokens during POC months.

kevin_dealdesk: Can you paste the current ratecard lines and the target economics? I need numbers to run the exception model.

maria_sales: Sure — current ratecard (tokens = 1k units):
```
base: $0.024 / 1k
commit-tier-1 (up to 500k): $0.018 / 1k
commit-tier-2 (500k-1M): $0.015 / 1k
burst (ephemeral): +25% on consumption price
```
We need a proposal for: 1) 6-week POC uplift (apply a one-time 12% discount to commit-tier-2 for POC months) 2) temporary burst cap at 2x for 4 weeks with a capped cost threshold 3) option to convert to a 12-month + reserved uplift with price protection.

kevin_dealdesk: Math check — if we give 12% off tier-2 for POC months, it reduces unit to ~$0.0132 /1k. With 2x burst allowance the worst-case uplift looks like +40% spend over baseline for the POC window. Need finance sign-off on downside exposure or a cap. :thinking_face:

linda_finance: We can approve a capped exposure if sales guarantees a minimum commit conversion within 90 days post-POC. Proposal: cap the POC spend uplift at $75k incremental above baseline; if exceeded, revert to standard burst pricing. Also require invoice schedule: POC billed monthly in arrears.

kevin_dealdesk: That cap is reasonable. We still need an approvals path: 1) Deal Desk approves exception 2) Legal signs the SOW w/ capped liability 3) Finance signs the cap. I can escalate to the approval queue if you confirm numbers.

ajay_se: Technical note — to hit their eval metrics we need KV cache pinned and an extra 16GB GPU for the nightly runs. That increases infra-backed cost ~ $6k/week. Include that as a line item in the SOW rather than bundling into per-token pricing.

sarah_cs: Arcadia already cleared the security questionnaire and SOC docs. They want price stability for Q3-Q4; they're sensitive to an increase after POC. Is there a path with a short-term discount + guaranteed rate floor?

maria_sales: Sales asks that we offer: - 12% temporary discount on tier-2 for the 6-week POC - burst allowed up to 2x for 4 weeks, subject to $75k cap - dedicated infra cost invoiced as separate line item - conversion option: commit to 12 months at a blended rate that splits the POC discount into a 5% ongoing uplift protection (i.e., a guaranteed floor no higher than +5% year-over-year)

kevin_dealdesk: I'll prepare an exception request. Need one more piece: expected token consumption curve during POC (weekly). Maria — can you supply a short table?

maria_sales: Yep, sending quick estimate: week1 0.8x baseline, week2 1.6x, week3 2.0x (burst), week4 1.8x, week5 1.1x, week6 1.0x.

pricing_bot: Automated calc — estimated incremental spend under proposed terms (before infra lines): ~$62,400 (below $75k cap). :white_check_mark:

kevin_dealdesk: Great — since pricing_bot is under the cap, I'll route to approvals. @linda_finance can you add your sign-off thread note when you have it?

linda_finance: Approved in principle. Please include monthly billing terms and a conversion milestone: customer must sign 12-month commit within 90 days post-POC or the one-time POC discount is clawed back on subsequent invoices.

kevin_dealdesk: Sounds good. I'll draft the exception doc and tag legal for SOW language. Expect a follow-up this afternoon. :thumbsup:

maria_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll update Arcadia and schedule a 30-min sync to review the SOW once legal chimes in. :calendar:
